def design(feats):
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, float); n, p = X.shape
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    labs = sorted(set(feats.stratum))
    Z = np.column_stack([np.ones(n)] + [np.array([s == l for s in feats.stratum], float) for l in labs[1:]])

    def ll(cols):
        A = np.column_stack([Z] + cols) if cols else Z
        b = np.zeros(A.shape[1])
        for _ in range(30):
            eta = np.clip(A @ b, -30, 30); mu = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-eta)); w = mu * (1 - mu) + 1e-9
            H = A.T @ (A * w[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(A.shape[1])
            step = np.linalg.solve(H, A.T @ (y - mu)); b += step
            if np.max(np.abs(step)) < 1e-7: break
        mu = np.clip(1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(A @ b, -30, 30))), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)
        return float(np.sum(y * np.log(mu) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - mu)))

    R = np.corrcoef(X.T); R = np.nan_to_num(R)
    col = lambda j: X[:, j]
    sel = []; base = ll([])
    for step in range(MAX_DRIVERS):
        alpha = (0.1 if step == 0 else 0.05) / p
        best, bj = -1, None
        for j in range(p):
            if j in sel or any(abs(R[j, k]) >= 0.6 for k in sel): continue
            g = 2 * (ll([col(k) for k in sel] + [col(j)]) - base)
            if g > best: best, bj = g, j
        if bj is None or stats.chi2.sf(best, 1) > alpha: break
        # cluster swap: among |r|>=0.6 members with LL within 2, choose min sum of other members' gains
        clus = [k for k in range(p) if abs(R[bj, k]) >= 0.6 and k not in sel]
        if len(clus) > 1:
            lls = {k: ll([col(m) for m in sel] + [col(k)]) for k in clus}
            top = max(lls.values()); cand = [k for k in clus if lls[k] >= top - 2]
            def sg(k):
                return sum(2 * (ll([col(m) for m in sel] + [col(k), col(o)]) - lls[k]) for o in clus if o != k)
            bj = min(cand, key=sg)
        sel.append(bj); base = ll([col(k) for k in sel])
    changed = True
    while changed and sel:
        changed = False
        full = ll([col(k) for k in sel])
        for k in list(sel):
            g = 2 * (full - ll([col(m) for m in sel if m != k]))
            if stats.chi2.sf(g, 1) > 0.05 / p:
                sel.remove(k); changed = True; break
    # product / square screen over all pairs, score prescreen then 1-df LR given both mains
    mu0 = np.full(n, y.mean()); r0 = y - mu0
    pairs = [(a, b) for a in range(p) for b in range(a, p)]
    P = np.stack([X[:, a] * X[:, b] for a, b in pairs], 1); P = (P - P.mean(0)) / (P.std(0) + 1e-9)
    sc = (P.T @ r0) ** 2 / (n * y.mean() * (1 - y.mean()))
    prods = []; alpha2 = 0.01 / len(pairs)
    for i in np.argsort(-sc)[:15]:
        a, b = pairs[i]
        mains = sorted(set(sel) | {a, b})
        l0 = ll([col(m) for m in mains]); l1 = ll([col(m) for m in mains] + [X[:, a] * X[:, b]])
        if stats.chi2.sf(2 * (l1 - l0), 1) < alpha2 and not any({a, b} & set(q) for q in prods):
            prods.append((a, b))
        if len(prods) >= 2: break
    drivers = list(sel)
    for a, b in prods:
        for m in (a, b):
            if m not in drivers: drivers.append(m)
    drivers = drivers[:MAX_DRIVERS]
    cols = sorted(set(sel) | {m for q in prods for m in q})
    return Design(drivers=tuple(ids[k] for k in drivers), columns=tuple(ids[k] for k in cols),
                  products=tuple((ids[a], ids[b]) for a, b in prods), loadings={})
